auth_details: Public endpoints need no auth. Private REST endpoints require API-Key and API-Sign headers (HMAC-SHA512 of nonce+POST data with base64-decoded secret), self-serve key creation in account settings.
free_tier_limits: API access included with account; no separate API fee. Trading subject to Kraken fee schedule by volume.
paid_plans: Volume-based trading fees; no separate API subscription tiers documented.
rate_limits: REST: counter-based (starts ~15, decays over time); private endpoints cost more. Exact counters vary by endpoint; WebSocket has separate limits. See docs for current tables.
description: Kraken provides REST and WebSocket APIs for spot and derivatives trading, market data, account balances, order management, and funding operations. Public market endpoints require no authentication; private account and trading endpoints use API key authentication with request signing. Widely used by traders and bots for automated exchange access.
resolution_notes: Auditor correct on base_url: docs use /0 path prefix; Futures is separate host. Spot REST base is https://api.kraken.com/0 (docs.kraken.com). Futures: futures.kraken.com/derivatives/api/v3.
